lines.japanese: 冬の乾いた空気が喉に張りついた。
lines.english: The dry winter air clung to my throat.

lines.japanese: 紫のネオンで照らされた排気ガスは、すでに見た目からして健康に悪い。
lines.english: The exhaust fumes glowing beneath purple neon looked unhealthy before I even breathed them.

lines.japanese: しかしここまで全力で走ってきた俺は、こんな固まりでもありがたく吸いこむしかなかったんだ。
lines.english: But after sprinting here at full speed, I had no choice but to gulp down the stuff gratefully.

lines.japanese: まあ要するに俺は、鳴との待ちあわせに遅刻した。
lines.english: In other words, I was late meeting Naru.

lines.japanese: 「悪い」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 片手を縦にして簡潔な謝罪。口ベタな俺には、ごちゃごちゃ言い訳するよりこっちの方が手っ取りばやい。
lines.english: I raised one hand in a brief apology. I wasn't good with words, so this was quicker than making a mess of excuses.

lines.japanese: 「言いわけしてください」
lines.english: “Give me an excuse.”

lines.japanese: だが鳴はごちゃごちゃ面倒なことを要求してきた。
lines.english: But Naru demanded that I make a mess of it.

lines.japanese: 「なんで」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「隼人さん、前にぜってー遅刻しないと宣言しましたから、なにかそれを覆す出来事でもあったのかと思いまして」
lines.english: “You declared before that you would never be late, so I assumed something must have happened to overrule that declaration.”

lines.japanese: ああ。したな、そんな約束。ていうかあんとき鳴はテンパってたから、覚えてないのかと思ってた。
lines.english: Oh. Right. I had promised that. She'd been so flustered at the time that I assumed she wouldn't remember.

lines.japanese: だけど俺が約束したのは事実で、今はその理由を求められている。それなら包みかくさず理由を答えた方がいいんだろう。
lines.english: But I had made the promise, and now she wanted a reason. I supposed I should answer without hiding anything.

lines.japanese: 「家を出るときに小鳩がセールスの電話に捕まって」
lines.english: “Kobato got trapped on a sales call while I was leaving.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、キューちゃん。はー、それなら仕方ないですよねー」
lines.english: “Oh, Kyuu. Well, that couldn't be helped.”

lines.japanese: 俺はあっさり無罪放免になった。
lines.english: I was immediately acquitted.

lines.japanese: こういうとき俺は、鳴をパートナーに選んでよかったと心から思える。家族の大切さを、俺のツレはよく分かってるんだ。出来た女だろ。
lines.english: At times like this, I felt from the bottom of my heart that I'd chosen the right partner. My woman understood the importance of family. Quite a catch, wasn't she?

lines.japanese: 「ま、それだけじゃねーんだけど。そのあと小鳩が、保険の電話に捕まって」
lines.english: “That wasn't all, though. Afterward, Kobato got trapped on a call about insurance.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、それは仕方ありませんねー」
lines.english: “Well, that couldn't be helped.”

lines.japanese: 「だろ。そんでそのあと、小鳩が食器洗ってたから手伝って」
lines.english: “Right? Then she started washing dishes, so I helped.”

lines.japanese: 「はー」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「そしたらそのあと、小鳩が宿題で苦戦してたから。はは、ちょっと手伝ってやったよ」
lines.english: “Then she was struggling with her homework. Hah, so I helped her with that too.”

lines.japanese: 「はー」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「いやでも俺、ベンキョーなんか分かんねーじゃん。だから結局だらだら話してたんだけど、まあたまには家族と話すのも悪くねえっつーか？　時間かかっちゃってさ」
lines.english: “But you know I don't understand schoolwork. We ended up sitting around talking. I mean, chatting with family once in a while isn't so bad, right? It took some time.”

lines.japanese: 「そうですかよく分かりました。それで今の話とは別件になるんですが、あの、そこちょっと座れよ」
lines.english: “I see. Your explanation is perfectly clear. On an entirely separate matter, sit down over there.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: おかしい、鳴の声に不満そうなトーンが加わってる。どうしちゃったんだろう。
lines.english: Strange. A note of displeasure had entered Naru's voice. What could be wrong?

lines.japanese: 「いや俺、思うんだけどさ。家族の大切さを知ってる女ってのはエレーよな」
lines.english: “You know what I think? A woman who understands the importance of family is pretty damn admirable.”

lines.japanese: 「はいエレーです。ですが、恋人を大切にしない男はエレーくないです」
lines.english: “Yes, she is. A man who doesn't value his girlfriend is not admirable.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿、そういうんじゃねえよ。大切にしてないなんて誰も言ってねえだろ。ただ、ほんのちょっぴり遅れちゃっただけの話だろ。そんな目くじら立てて怒んなよ」
lines.english: “Idiot, that's not what this is. Nobody said I don't value you. I was only a tiny bit late. Don't get so bent out of shape.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、前から気になってたんですけどっ」
lines.english: “There's something I've been wondering for a while!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。なに」
lines.english: “Yeah? What?”

lines.japanese: 「隼人さんってシスコンじゃありません？」
lines.english: “Hayato, don't you have a sister complex?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 全く心当たりがない。なにを言ってるんだこいつは。
lines.english: I couldn't imagine what she meant. What was she talking about?

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿おまえ、それはちげーって。そりゃおまえの兄貴みたいなんはそのカテゴリーかもしんねえけど、うちは普通じゃん。ごく普通じゃん」
lines.english: “Idiot, no. Maybe your brother belongs in that category, but my family is normal. Completely normal.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、そうですかねー」
lines.english: “Oh. Is that so?”

lines.japanese: 「当たり前だっつの。勘弁しろよ。彼氏の妹にまでジェラシーとか、やりすぎだろ。そらやりすぎだわ。そらよくねえわ」
lines.english: “Of course. Come on. Getting jealous of your boyfriend's little sister is going too far. Way too far. Not healthy.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ隼人さん、キューちゃんと私が駅で別れるとしたら、どっちを家まで送っていきますか」
lines.english: “Then if Kyuu and I were parting at the station, which of us would you walk home?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 俺は素で困った顔を浮かべてしまった。
lines.english: My face showed entirely genuine distress.

lines.japanese: 「うわああっ！　このひとシスコンだあー！」
lines.english: “Aaaah! He does have a sister complex!”

lines.japanese: 鳴はドン引いていた。
lines.english: Naru recoiled in horror.

lines.japanese: 「ばっ、馬鹿ちょっ、ちげーって。年の差考えろよ、おまえもう充分大人なんだから、一人でなんでも出来るお年頃だろ。一人で帰してもなんの問題もねえだろ」
lines.english: “I-idiot, wait. That's different. Think about the age gap. You're already an adult who can do anything by herself. There's no problem letting you walk home alone.”

lines.japanese: 「そういう問題じゃないですよー、もー。隼人さん覚束なーい。心許なーい。あーあ、鳴さん見知らぬ男に声かけられてどっか行っちゃうー」
lines.english: “That’s not the point! Honestly, Hayato, you’re no help. I can’t count on you. Oh dear, some strange man’s going to chat me up, and off I’ll go with him.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせ、うるせっつんだよ。俺のオンナが、んな情けねえこと言ってんじゃねえよ。つかおまえ、声とかかけられんの。そんな可能性あんの」
lines.english: “Shut up. I said shut up. My woman shouldn't say something so pathetic. Wait, do men actually approach you? Is that a possibility?”

lines.japanese: 「なっ！　失礼な、ありますよそのぐらい！　たまに」
lines.english: “How rude! Of course it is! Sometimes.”

lines.japanese: 「ああいや、そういう馬鹿にした意味じゃなくて。むしろ心配ンなったから聞いたんだけど」
lines.english: “No, I wasn't making fun of you. I asked because now I'm worried.”

lines.japanese: 「後付けでしょー、もー、いい。今日は一人で帰る」
lines.english: “You just made that up. Fine. I’m going home by myself today.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ？　勝手にしろ」
lines.english: “What? Do what you want.”

lines.japanese: 「ああーっ！　このひと、引きとめもしないー！」
lines.english: “Aaaah! He isn't even trying to stop me!”

lines.japanese: 「いやちょっ……だっておまえが帰るっつったんじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Wait... You're the one who said you were leaving.”

lines.japanese: 「わーん、どーせ隼人さんは、私よりキューちゃんの方が大切なんだー！」
lines.english: “Waaah! Hayato cares more about Kyuu than he does about me!”

lines.japanese: 「おふっ！」
lines.english: “Mmph!”

lines.japanese: 鳴は手に持っていた猫を俺の顔へ押しつけると、俺に背を向けて駆けはじめた。
lines.english: Naru shoved the cat she was holding into my face, turned her back on me, and ran.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、なんだこれ。おー、ちょい待てって！　どーすんだこれ」
lines.english: “Wait, what's this? Hey, hold on! What am I supposed to do with it?”

lines.japanese: 「キューちゃんにでもあげればいいじゃないですかー！」
lines.english: “Give it to Kyuu!”

lines.japanese: 捨てゼリフ一つ残して、小さい体が人混みの中へ紛れていった。
lines.english: With that parting shot, her small figure disappeared into the crowd.

lines.japanese: タイミングの悪いことに、電車が到着したばかりで、駅前広場には降りてきた乗客たちがごった返していた。鳴の姿はすぐに見えなくなった。
lines.english: As luck would have it, a train had just arrived, and the plaza was packed with passengers leaving the station. Naru vanished from sight at once.

lines.japanese: って、べつにタイミング悪くねえよ。勝手にしろ。
lines.english: Not that the timing was bad. She could do whatever she wanted.

lines.japanese: つか、このネコ俺が持って帰ンのか……。
lines.english: Was I supposed to take this cat home... ?

lines.japanese: なんかこんなモン持って歩くのは俺のキャラじゃねえよな。うん、これは鳴に持って帰らせよう。
lines.english: Walking around with a thing like this wasn't my style. Right. I'd make Naru take it home.

lines.japanese: べつに言いすぎて気になるとかじゃねんだけど、猫を持って帰らせなきゃいけないので、俺は広場の中から鳴の姿を探しはじめた。
lines.english: It wasn't that I'd said too much and felt bad. I merely had to make her take the cat, so I began searching the plaza for her.

lines.japanese: いやほんと、ちょっぴり意地張ってごめんとか思ってるわけじゃないんだけどな。うるせえよ、そういうことにしとけよ。ブッ殺すぞコノヤ――
lines.english: Seriously. I did not think I should apologize for being a little stubborn. Shut up. That's the story, so accept it or I'll fucking kill—

lines.japanese: ――あ、いた。
lines.english: —there she was.

lines.japanese: と思ったら、なんだか知らない男に声かけられてる。くだらねえキャッチだった。
lines.english: And some man I didn't know was talking to her. A worthless street recruiter.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのだから私、制服ですしあのその、そういう場所への立ち入りは校則でも禁じられてまして」
lines.english: “U-um, I'm in uniform, and the school rules forbid me from entering that kind of establishment.”

lines.japanese: 「ダイジョブだって、着替える服なら用意してあッから。つか、ホストクラブなんて行ったら、クラスで英雄よ？　チョー自慢できんぜ？　俺も学生ンころキャバクラ行ったけどさー」
lines.english: “It's fine. We've got clothes you can change into. Besides, you go to a host club and you'll be a hero to your class. You'll have so much to brag about. I went to a hostess club when I was a student.”

lines.japanese: まあ、俺の女に声かけるなんざ、ひとを見る目だけはある。俺は苦笑しながら、問答を繰りひろげる男女の間へ割って入った。
lines.english: Well, a man who approached my woman at least had a good eye. Smiling wryly, I stepped between them.

lines.japanese: 「い、いえっ！　結構です、結構でもふっ！」
lines.english: “N-no! I'm fine, I'm really fi—mmph!”

lines.japanese: 「忘れモン」
lines.english: “You forgot this.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「……隼人さん？」
lines.english: “...Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ？」
lines.english: “Yeah?”

lines.japanese: 「テメこんなもん俺に持って歩かせるんじゃねえよ。ハードボイルド台無しじゃねえか、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Don't make me walk around carrying this thing. It ruins my hard-boiled image. I'll fucking kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ……そのために来てくれたんですか」
lines.english: “What...? You came back just for that?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ？　あァまァそうだけど、そのためだけど。まあおまえにはそれだけの用事だったんだけど、なんか別の用事ができちゃったから、今から済ませるとこ」
lines.english: “What? Yeah, pretty much. That was all I needed from you. But now something else has come up, so I'm gonna handle it.”

lines.japanese: ぐいっ。俺は鳴の肩を抱いて、体ごと自分の脇腹へ引きよせた。
lines.english: I wrapped an arm around Naru's shoulders and pulled her bodily against my side.

lines.japanese: 「で、こいつ俺の彼女なんだけどなんか用」
lines.english: “This is my girlfriend. You need something?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「超自慢の愛しの彼女なんだけどなんか用」
lines.english: “My beloved girlfriend, who I'm insanely proud of. You need something?”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええっ？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 俺は意地を張った詫びのつもり――じゃなくて、相手に分かりやすく伝えるため、俺たちの関係を強調して見せつけた。
lines.english: I made a point of emphasizing our relationship so he would understand—not because I owed her an apology for being stubborn.

lines.japanese: 「はッ？　おまえ邪魔なンだけど」
lines.english: “The hell? You're in my way.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで。俺、彼氏なんだけど」
lines.english: “Why? I'm her boyfriend.”

lines.japanese: しばらく広場の中で凄みあう。周りの連中もただならぬ様子に足を止めはじめた。
lines.english: We glared each other down in the middle of the plaza. People nearby began stopping at the dangerous atmosphere.

lines.japanese: 通りがかった女に誘いをかけるのは、れっきとした連中のビジネスだ。夜の街が庭代わりの俺だから、そのぐらいの理解はある。
lines.english: Inviting women off the street was these men's legitimate business. The nightlife district was my backyard, so I understood that much.

lines.japanese: しかし、あまりにしつこいようなら話は別だ。
lines.english: But excessive persistence was another matter.

lines.japanese: 「まだ俺のオンナに用があるっつーなら、お兄さんが相手してあげるけど」
lines.english: “If you still want something from my woman, you can deal with me.”

lines.japanese: 俺はより凄みを利かせた。仲間のキャッチもいて強気になっていたんだろう、声をかけてきた男は素に戻って一歩後ずさった。
lines.english: I put more menace into my voice. He'd probably felt bold with fellow recruiters nearby, but now he came back to himself and stepped away.

lines.japanese: そのとき、交番の方に群衆の一人が声をかけに行くのが見えた。
lines.english: At that moment, I saw someone in the crowd heading toward the police box to report us.

lines.japanese: 「かー、ウゼッ。馬鹿が、キャッチ相手にマジギレしてんじゃねえよ」
lines.english: “God, what a pain. Idiot, don't lose your mind over some street recruiter.”

lines.japanese: ちょうどいい引き際だと思ったんだろう。キャッチの男は退散し、仲間の元へ戻っていった。
lines.english: He must have decided it was a good moment to withdraw. He left and rejoined his friends.

lines.japanese: 「あにょ」
「平気」
lines.english: “You okay?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい。ぜんぜん。すぐに隼人さんが来てくれましたし」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. Completely. You came right away.”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう。つかアレな。おまえ実はモテキャラだったのな」
lines.english: “Good. So this is what you meant. You're secretly the popular type.”

lines.japanese: 「はい？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「いやだからアレだ。一人じゃ危ないだろ。一人で歩かせたら、またすぐロクでもねー連中がやってきて、声とかかけられちゃうだろ」
lines.english: “I mean, well... You're not safe alone. The second I let you walk somewhere by yourself, some other worthless assholes will come talk to you.”

lines.japanese: 「だからほらアレだ。変な虫がつかないように、あの、ちょっと家まで送らせてくんない」
lines.english: “So, uh... to keep the creeps away, could you let me walk you home?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、いいんですか？」
lines.english: “Really? You will?”

lines.japanese: 「あとほら、まだ時間早いじゃん。家まで帰る途中にも、寄れるとこいっぱいあんじゃん」
lines.english: “And it's still early, right? There are plenty of places we could stop on the way.”

lines.japanese: 「だからメシでも食いながらその辺ぶらついて、それから送らせてくんない」
lines.english: “So how about we grab something to eat, wander around a little, and then I walk you home?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ」
lines.english: “Hah.”

lines.japanese: 「はわわわあーっ！」
lines.english: “Hawawawaaa!”

lines.japanese: 途端、それまでぽかん顔を浮かべていた鳴が息を吹きかえした。くそ、ちっとサービスしすぎだったんじゃないのか俺。
lines.english: The vacant look vanished from Naru's face, and life rushed back into her. Shit. Had I laid it on a little too thick?

lines.japanese: 「おっ、送ってー！　隼人送ってー！　どこまででも送ってー！」
lines.english: “Walk me home! Hayato, walk me home! Walk me anywhere!”

lines.japanese: とはいえあんまり鳴が嬉しそうにはしゃぎ始めたもんだから、ついこっちも笑いが漏れてしまった。
lines.english: But she started bouncing around so happily that a laugh escaped me too.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、はいはい」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「やーんもう素敵ー！　隼人素敵ー！　んもう素敵ー！」
lines.english: “Oh, you're wonderful! Hayato, you're wonderful! So wonderful!”

lines.japanese: 「素敵素敵って、テメそれしか誉め言葉知らねえのかよ。もっとあんじゃん、クールとかハードボイルドとか俺っぽいの」
lines.english: “Wonderful, wonderful. Is that the only compliment you know? There are other words that suit me. Cool. Hard-boiled.”

lines.japanese: 「やーんもう素敵ー！　隼人素敵ー！　んもう素敵ー！」
lines.english: “Oh, you're wonderful! Hayato, you're wonderful! So wonderful!”

lines.japanese: 「てめガン無視かよ」
lines.english: “You're completely ignoring me.”

lines.japanese: こいつらしいや。俺は肩を抱いていたのをいいことに、そのままの状態で歩きはじめた。
lines.english: That was like her. Since my arm was already around her shoulders, I simply started walking that way.

lines.japanese: 「やーんもうさっきの隼人さんはすすす素敵でしたー！　『俺の女に手を出すな』。きゃー痺れるー！　ときめくー！　言われてみたい台詞ベスト３以内ー！」
lines.english: “Oh, Hayato, you were so, so, so wonderful just now! ‘Don't touch my woman.’ Ah, it sent shivers through me! My heart's racing! That's in the top three things I want a man to say to me!”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ、ほらさっさと歩け。あと口閉じろ口」
lines.english: “Shut up. Walk faster. And close your mouth.”

lines.japanese: 「やーんもうグイグイ引っぱってく男の子素敵ー！　どこまでも連れていってー」
lines.english: “Oh, a forceful boy who drags me along! Wonderful! Take me anywhere!”

lines.japanese: 「口閉じろ口」
lines.english: “Close your mouth.”

lines.japanese: 「胸が高鳴るー！」
lines.english: “My heart is pounding!”
